description: Search for hotels in a destination with comprehensive filtering and pagination options. Use when the user wants a place to stay in a destination for check-in and check-out dates. Dates are DD.MM.YYYY. Each hotel has a detail_link where the user books on the site. For cheaper or the cheapest hotels, use sort=price; for a budget, max_price with price_per (total or night); for breakfast or another board, board_type. Prices are for the whole stay (price_per_night is the nightly figure). total_hotels is how many hotels match; for more, increase page. For a hotel's rooms and prices, pass its id as hotel_id to hotel_room_detail.

children.description: Ages of children as list (e.g., [8, 12] for 8 and 12 year olds)

limit.description: Number of results per page (max 7, default: 7)

max_price.description: Maximum price in the result currency (the user's budget)

min_price.description: Minimum price in the result currency

price_per.description: Whether min_price/max_price are for the whole stay ('total', default) or per night ('night')

sort.description: Sort order: 'recommended' (default), 'price' (cheapest first; use for cheaper/cheapest requests) or 'rating'

name: hotel_search
title: Search hotels
